points.description: States that the storage volume vs elevation relationship (storage–elevation curve) of the reservoir must be known.
States that the inflow hydrograph must be known.
States that the water surface elevation vs outflow relationship (elevation–discharge/outflow curve) must be known.
States that the initial values of storage (S), inflow (I) and outflow (Q) at t = 0 must be known; all three must be given.
points.partial_credit: Initial conditions given but only two of S, I, Q named earns 0.25.

rubric.notes: Award marks only for each of the four required details stated precisely with the correct relationship (storage vs elevation, inflow hydrograph, elevation vs outflow, initial S, I, Q at t=0). Vague mentions such as "reservoir data" or "flow data" earn nothing. A wrong extra item (e.g. rainfall intensity, evaporation) cancels the mark for the point it is attached to or any point it contradicts; only the initial-values point can earn half marks.
